answer: Embodied Work Receipts. Each identity must periodically submit a continuous sensor log of physical labor whose trajectory forms a single unbroken spiral (e.g., hand-grinding, sweeping a defined route). Verification checks trajectory smoothness, actuator energy, and re-identification on a private island—the log must match the operator’s registered physical signature, closing any hollow gaps from scripted playback. Each submission costs one hour of verified real labor; faking N identities demands N independent bodies.
